title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Student → FERPARestriction
architecture_notes: Workday Student manages FERPA directory-information restrictions through Privacy settings / Student Privacy flags. When a student requests a FERPA block, directory information must be withheld from disclosure. Equivalent to PS_SCC_PRTCTN (privacy protection) / FERPA service indicators.

source_objects.description: FERPA restriction flags: what directory info is restricted, effective date. Equivalent to PS_SCC_PRTCTN + FERPA service indicators.
The categories a student can restrict: name, address, phone, email, enrollment status, degrees, honors, photo.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map or composite of student + type.
Array: which directory items are withheld (name, address, phone, email, enrollment, degrees, honors, photo).
Boolean. Master flag: withhold all directory info.
Cast to ISO 8601. When the restriction took effect.
Null if indefinite. FERPA blocks persist until the student removes them.
When the student made the request.

notes: This resource is itself a FERPA compliance control. Any consumer of HELIX student data MUST check for an active FERPARestriction before disclosing directory information. Downstream systems (lakehouse, dashboards, third-party disclosures) must honor these flags — see govern/classification-handling-rules.json for the directory_information handling rule.
